subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: What shared inbound attachment metadata shape should agents receive for Slack, Discord, Telegram, and future channel plugins?
rationale: The remaining gap changes the channel-to-agent context contract, and a Slack-only field would likely become a competing source of truth for attachment data.

options.title: Design shared attachment metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

options.title: Slack-only stopgap
options.body: Expose Slack file metadata only, accepting future migration risk if other channels need a different shape.

options.title: Keep placeholder workflow
options.body: Keep the current fileId placeholder plus download-file model and close this as not planned after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design shared attachment metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already in the issue discussion and have recent Slack media-path history, making them the best available owner for choosing the contract direction.
